notes: 57 references. Ref 42 (Kannaiyan 2022) was a C01 false positive: Crossref lists it with the author's names swapped (family 'Vivek') and '&' in the title. Since HTML entities are decoded in titles it is a probable match under a variant title (similarity 0.87), not flagged. Ref 11 is genuinely unverifiable.

expected.why: Puri 2020, IDA Lud J-le Dent. Searched by hand in Crossref (bibliographic) and OpenAlex on 2026-10-27: no record of this work. 'Could not be verified' is accurate; the work may exist outside both indexes.
Sahana 2016 J Int Soc Prev Community Dent (DOI matches) retracted 2016-07-25 for plagiarism; paper published 2023-11-18 = 87 months later.
